item.title: Build Environment
item.description:
Build Environment#

The scratch3-tello repository contains per-file diffs for the scratch-vm and scratch-gui repositories. To build Scratch3-Tello, you need to clone scratch-vm and scratch-gui and then apply the diffs.

Requirements#

  • wget
  • git
  • node.js
  • npm

Create a working directory#

$ mkdir scratch3-tello
$ cd scratch3-tello

Download the build script#

$ wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kebhr/scratch3-tello/master/build.sh
$ chmod +x build.sh

Run the build script#

$ ./build.sh

Running build.sh will automatically clone scratch-vm, scratch-gui, and scratch-desktop, and apply the diff files managed by the scratch3-tello repository.

item.title: For Windows
item.description:
For Windows#

Download#

Go to Releases on GitHub and download the file named windows.zip.

Extract#

Extract the downloaded zip file to a location of your choice.

Launch#

After connecting to Tello, launch Scratch3-Tello.exe, which is contained in the extracted folder.

Once launched, click the Extensions button in the lower-left corner and select the “Tello” extension. The blocks for programming Tello will appear.

Troubleshooting#

If Tello does not take off after running the takeoff block, commands from other blocks may be queued and waiting to execute. Running the “Reset command queue” block should resolve the issue.

item.title: For macOS
item.description:
For macOS#

Download#

Go to Releases on GitHub and download the file named macos.zip.

Extract#

Extract the downloaded zip file to a location of your choice.

Launch#

After connecting to Tello, launch Scratch-Tello.app, which is contained in the extracted folder.

On the first launch, macOS security restrictions will prevent you from opening the application by double-clicking. Instead, hold the Control key and click the app, then select “Open” from the context menu.

item.title: Internationalization
item.description:
Internationalization#

NOTE: Pull requests are always welcome to add or update translations. If you can translate but are not familiar with GitHub, please contact me, and I will add your translation to Scratch3-Tello.

Block names are defined in scratch-vm/src/extensions/scratch3_tello/index.js. The message object defined in this file is used for i18n.

item.title: For Linux
item.description:
For Linux#

Pre-built binaries for Linux are not currently available. To run Scratch3-Tello on Linux, please refer to Build Environment and build it yourself.

NOTE: It has been confirmed to work on Ubuntu 18.04.1.
